focusedFinding.summary: The production thermal predicate treats normal pmset sentences containing “No ... warning ... recorded” as a warning, so a healthy actual host is always marked thermalNormal=false for this output shape.
focusedFinding.requiredResolution: Parse affirmative warning state rather than the bare word warning; add actual-output regression; re-review before API/E2E rerun.

separateEnvironmentPrerequisites.note: Even after source repair, the user/runner must connect AC power and provision least-privilege noninteractive permission for exactly /usr/sbin/purge.

gatingDecision.reason: A production implementation defect is directly reproduced at the mandatory preflight boundary; downstream package construction and qualification stop fail-closed.
